message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering credible public vulnerability reports and advisory updates observed in the last 24 hours before the scheduled run at 2026-07-31 05:10 IST. Confirmed relevant updates were found for Google Chrome, VMware vCenter/ESXi, Ubuntu/OpenSSL, and Ubuntu Linux kernel packages. No fresh credible findings were confirmed for the other monitored products in this window.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: Stable Channel Update for Desktop, including CVE-2026-17650 through CVE-2026-18019
- Severity: At least one issue is listed as Critical by the Chrome release source; other severities vary across the large CVE set.
- Description: Google released Chrome 151.0.7922.71/.72 with hundreds of security fixes. Public CERT coverage describes exploitation impact that could include remote code execution, denial of service, information disclosure, security restriction bypass, or tampering if a user opens crafted web content in a vulnerable browser.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Google Chrome, and the alert explicitly applies to Google Chrome versions before 151.0.7922.71.
- Source: Chrome Releases https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/07/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0887107924.html; GovCERT.HK A26-07-49 https://www.govcert.gov.hk/en/alerts_detail.php?id=1989

**Finding 2**

- Product: VMware vCenter / VMware ESXi
- Issue: VMSA-2026-0006: CVE-2026-59309, CVE-2026-59310, CVE-2026-47876, CVE-2026-41703, and CVE-2026-41709
- Severity: Critical overall; Broadcom lists a CVSSv3 range of 2.7-9.8.
- Description: Broadcom published updates for multiple VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, and Fusion vulnerabilities. The highest-impact issues include vCenter authentication bypass and directory traversal flaws rated up to CVSS 9.8, plus an ESX VMXNET3 out-of-bounds write rated up to CVSS 9.3.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes VMware ESXi and VMware vCenter, and the Broadcom advisory explicitly lists VMware vSphere ESXi and VMware vCenter Server among affected products.
- Source: Broadcom VMSA-2026-0006 https://support.broadcom.com/web/ecx/support-content-notification/-/external/content/SecurityAdvisories/0/38017; GovCERT.HK A26-07-50 https://www.govcert.gov.hk/en/alerts_detail.php?id=1990

**Finding 3**

- Product: Ubuntu / OpenSSL
- Issue: USN-8625-1: OpenSSL HollowByte denial-of-service issue
- Severity: Not clearly stated in the Ubuntu notice.
- Description: Ubuntu published OpenSSL package updates for an SSL/TLS state-machine memory allocation issue that could allow a remote attacker to cause excessive memory consumption and denial of service using crafted network traffic.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes both Ubuntu and OpenSSL, and Ubuntu lists affected releases including 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, and 26.04 LTS.
- Source: Ubuntu USN-8625-1 https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8625-1; OpenSSL project discussion https://openssl-library.org/post/2026-07-21-hollowbyte/

**Finding 4**

- Product: Ubuntu / Linux kernel
- Issue: USN-8622-1 and USN-8623-1: Linux kernel (NVIDIA) vulnerabilities; CVE-2026-53354 and CVE-2026-64520
- Severity: Not clearly stated as a single severity in the Ubuntu notices.
- Description: Ubuntu published kernel updates for NVIDIA kernel packages correcting security issues in ARM64 and Arm Firmware Framework for ARMv8-A components. Ubuntu says the flaws could possibly be used to compromise the system.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Ubuntu, and the notices explicitly apply to Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and/or 26.04 LTS kernel packages.
- Source: Ubuntu USN-8622-1 https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8622-1; Ubuntu USN-8623-1 https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8623-1

**Possible Matches Needing Review**

- Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center CVE-2026-20316 was reported as exploited and added to public alerting, but it was not included as a confirmed finding because Products.txt names Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender rather than Cisco Secure FMC. Source: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-fmc-static-cred-BET3Cjh
- Fortinet FortiSandbox CVE-2026-39808 appeared in vulnerability-index results dated 2026-07-30, but it was not included as a confirmed finding because Products.txt names Fortigate/FortiOS and I did not verify a FortiGate or FortiOS impact from a primary Fortinet advisory in this run.
- MongoDB: MongoDB-adjacent searches covered MongoDB Server, Atlas, drivers, and related components. The credible MongoDB items observed were older than the requested 24-hour window, so none were included as confirmed new findings.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for VMware vCenter/ESXi because Broadcom’s advisory includes Critical issues up to CVSS 9.8. Chrome and Ubuntu/OpenSSL updates should also be prioritized through normal workstation and server patch workflows.
